item.title: [6.8] AI rockets to top of worries about financial system in latest Fed survey
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson emphasized inflation as the main factor in determining monetary policy. He highlighted that economic growth and a stable labor market have been observed. Jefferson indicated that upcoming adjustments to policy should rely on data trends and the evolving economic outlook.

WHY IT MATTERS

Directly impacts monetary policy expectations, interest rate trajectories, and global asset pricing.

item.title: [6.8] BofA adds January Fed hike to forecast, says quarterly pace no longer enough
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

BofA Global Research anticipates that the Federal Reserve will implement a rate hike in January 2027. This adjustment follows the unexpectedly high Consumer Price Index report for October. Expectations of a 25-basis-point increase are supported by increasing inflation driven by various factors.

WHY IT MATTERS

A major Wall Street bank shifting its Fed rate hike timeline in response to hot inflation data is a meaningful macro signal for market participants.
